title: Make a combination of alphabetical collation and manual resorting by DND the default behavior
line: Tasks sorted alphabetically (or any other way) can now be rearranged by dragging them, without changing the sorting setting first.
explanation: The Task Manager only reorders tasks on drag when its sort mode is Manually; in Alphabetically and the other automatic modes the drag ran but nothing moved, so the order could not be adjusted by hand. The change lets a drag work in every sort mode: the first move switches the widget's sorting setting to Manually, which starts from the order currently shown, and then moves the task.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: switch to manual sorting when dragging a task

Dragging a task did nothing unless sorting was set to Manually, so tasks
sorted alphabetically or otherwise could never be rearranged by hand. A
drag now switches the widget to manual sorting, keeping the current order.

BUG: 342966

media.caption: Sorted alphabetically: dragging Konsole onto Info Center (drag image visible) leaves the order unchanged.
Same drag with the fix: Konsole moves before Info Center (top: before the drag, bottom: after).
The drag in Alphabetical mode, without the fix: nothing moves.
The same drag with the fix: the task moves and stays.
